title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start the stream!
Five, four, three...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: It's the MORE MORE JUMP! Birthday livestream♪

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Here we go!!!!>
<Happy birthday, Shizuku!>
<Happy B-Day, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much for your kind words, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've been through a lot together since we started doing these streams, haven't we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm no longer the perfect Shizuku Hinomori I used to be, and I know that I've disappointed some of you by trying to just be myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But between the show we did with Nanamin, singing for all of you for the first time and helping with the graduation ceremony for that elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Each day has been absolutely wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And my hope is that we can keep enjoying these amazing experiences together.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's why I'm here!>
<MMJ for life!>
<This goes way beyond amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at all the comments!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, everything from, “Your streams are always so fun,” to, “Getting to know more about everyone is so cool!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, look at this one... “I love the way you smile, Shizuku!” Also, “She's a little clumsy, but way too cute at the same time.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all so much.
I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you'll allow me, I'd like to read some of your comments.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
“What?! Really?!”
“How many?! All of them?!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. My goal is to interact and celebrate with all of you as much as I can today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'll be reading through more comments than usual.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Comment as much as you like, everyone!
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Today was so much fun. Our stream went well, and I was able to celebrate with everybody in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me. There were some messages on my phone that I haven't gotten around to yet.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, another one... Two...?
They're from Ena and Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Shizuku!
Mizuki and were just talking, and wondering if things have settled down now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Mizuki's probably gonna send you something in a second, and we have some presents ready for you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'd like to give them to you the next time we have a chance, so let us know when you're free to hang out.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They've prepared presents for me too? And speaking of Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Shizuku!
Great stream today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ena and I were watching while on voice chat♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And thank you so much for reading our comments! That was so cool! Oh, but you probably didn't realize that it was us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ena was so determined to get you to read one of her comments too. You should've seen how furiously she was typing!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<She wrote, “Way to go, Airi!”
...which Airi read and made her really happy♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
I'll make sure to rewatch it later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: First, I'll reply to Ena...
Shizuku, dinner's ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'll be right there. I just need to reply to some messages first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii? You can go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But there's something I'd like to give you first.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-Is this...? My birthday present?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What else would it be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, you should wait until...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this is so cute! A pass case in the shape of a sparrow! I was just thinking about getting a new one too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii!
But how did you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mentioned it during dinner the other day, remember? The one you have right now is starting to come apart, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And how the illustration you like so much won't hold together at this rate or something...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So wouldn't it make sense to replace it while it's still intact...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sh-Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You remembered just for me?!
I... I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This case even has two little sparrows on it, and they look so cute together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
These must be sisters!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not really sure about that, but I thought you'd like it if there was more than one on it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Th-That's so thoughtful of you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I love you so much, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: O-Okay, I get it! So please...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hinomori. I know that being an idol can't be easy, but you're always welcome at the archery club. We're always happy to have you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shizuku! I know we really just met, but thank you for everything you've done. I hope you, Airi and I can keep getting to know each other better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku♪
It's so great to have a sewing buddy like you! Let's hit up the sewing lounge together again sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho told me that you're already using the hot-water bottle I gave you. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I saw your picture! That hooded towel I got you? The one that looks like a bird? I'm glad it looks so good on you♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About the canary wallet that I gave you... You can put coins into it by opening its beak, so it looks like you're feeding it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
I have so much respect for the way you work so hard to perfect everything! I promise to do my best too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shizuku. I really appreciate how you're always so thoughtful. I hope we get another chance to hang out together the next time we're free.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm usually too shy to say this, but you really are the best idol in my book... Let's keep trying our best and stand proud as idols!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku.
I don't mind talking while we're at school, but a little less physical contact would be nice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday like this, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
All these kind words...
I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so happy and blushing with joy♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that didn't sound quite right?
Did I mean, “Bursting with joy”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm not sure what else to say in this situation... Hehe. Let's just leave it there for now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm just glad you understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I promise to keep doing everything I can to spread and inspire hope in others as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to your support!
